text:
alex: heads-up — deploy-bot just sent a noisy KV cache regression alert for canary in us-west1, p95 token latency +35% over baseline. seeing it on embeddings route only.

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary/us-west1 | route=embeddings | p95_latency=420ms (+35%) | trigger_count=4 | auto-revert_threshold=3 | action=AUTOREVERT_SUGGESTED

sam: who is on late shift? can we hold autosafe? i don't want an auto-revert to blow past our midroll plan.

maria: i'm awake, can join. quick triage: is this KV cache miss storm or kernel perf? alex, can you paste the stack traces / svc logs?

alex: pasted logs in thread: ```kubectl logs svc/embeddings-canary --since=5m | tail -n 80``` showing repeated `kvcache.miss` spikes and `slot_eviction` warnings. not seeing GPU saturation.

ops-bot: NOTE: current deploy window is locked until 02:00 UTC. Auto-revert policy: if deploy-bot sees >=3 sustained p95 regressions across 5m, it will initiate revert unless a human "hold" is set.

emily: ok, plan proposal: 1) hold autosafe immediately (sam/maria to ack) 2) pin canary traffic off embeddings route to previous model variant (partial traffic split) 3) start rollback runbook for embeddings only 4) comms: short note to #customer-impact if pinned >15m

sam: ack hold autosafe. i'm setting `deploybot.hold=true` now.

alex: hold set. i'll prepare the partial pin command — we can route embeddings traffic to v2.12 which has different KV keys. command: `infractl route set embeddings --canary=0 --variant=v2.12 --reason="kv_regression"`

jon: do we need legal/enterprise notify? any dedicated customers on that canary shard?

emily: checked list — two mid-market customers are on that canary slice (acct: BrightLeaf, acct: CourseWave). product lead oncall notified (cc @maria). draft message: "We observed a transient embeddings latency spike in a canary deployment. We've routed embeddings traffic away from the affected version and are monitoring. No customer data exposure. Will update in 15 minutes."

maria: fine, send to #customer-impact. I'll prepare release-note blurb: "Pinned embeddings model variant in us-west1 due to KV cache regression during canary. Reverted to v2.12 for stability; investigating root cause, follow-up in postmortem."

ops-bot: RUNBOOK STEP: Partial rollback (embeddings) initiated by alex at 4470012368. Action: route switch + confirm health checks. Expected window: 5-10m.

alex: executed `infractl route set` at 4470012368 -> response ok. health checks passing 3/3. latency p95 back to 160ms.

deply-bot: LOG: autorevert suppressed due to `deploybot.hold=true` by sam. Manual partial rollback completed.

sam: good job. next: add short post to release-notes and flag for follow-up in tomorrow's infra retro. also open an incident if we see recurrence.

emily: i've posted to #customer-impact and pinned the thread. copying draft to #release-notes-drafts.

jon: quick checklist for handoff: - create incident ticket with logs & timestamps - attach `infractl` commands used - assign to eng-runtime for root cause - timeline for customers (emily)

maria: i'll take incident owner. assigning to eng-runtime; ETA for initial RCA 24 hours.

alex: adding a note in the deployment metadata: `rollback.partial=embeddings`, `rollback.reason=kvcache_miss_spike`, `operator=sam`, `started=4470012368`.

ops-bot: REMINDER: unset `deploybot.hold` after postmortem decision. If unset prematurely, auto-revert may re-enable.

emily: leaving hold in place for now. once eng-runtime confirms fix or we decide to roll forward, we'll coordinate un-hold and a planned canary re-run. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks everyone. closing thread after postmortem assigned. if anyone sees fresh alerts, ping @oncall immediately.
